title: Possible duplicate bills or payments
prompt: Find possible duplicate bills or payments this year: same vendor and the same or nearly the same amount within 30 days.

setup.q: Which vendors legitimately bill the same amount repeatedly (rent, subscriptions) and should be excluded?

steps: pull this year's bills and bill payments with vendor, date and amount
run duplicate_pairs (same vendor, same or near amount, within 30 days) with the excluded vendors removed
for each pair, say why it is a candidate and which source each entry came from

done.text: Every exception row cites both entry ids and their sources
duplicate-candidates.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Each candidate pair gives a reason; recurring same-amount vendors from setup are not listed
